headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 29, 2026**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians secured a thrilling 6-5 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Kyle Manzardo leading the charge at the plate. Manzardo's impressive performance included a home run and 4 RBIs. In a separate matchup, the Cincinnati Reds bounced back to take down the Guardians 2-0, with Jose Franco earning the win. JJ Bleday led the Reds' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Casey Schmitt has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left knee meniscus tear. The Minnesota Twins have also suffered injuries, with Cole Sands and Mike Paredes being placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right elbow strain and left oblique strain, respectively. Kerry Carpenter has been placed on the 10-day injured list with left foot plantar fasciitis, while Spencer Steer is out with a right wrist sprain.

The Pittsburgh Pirates made a notable trade, acquiring right fielder Johnathan Rodríguez from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for cash. The San Diego Padres have signed shortstop Nu'u Contrades, while the Chicago White Sox acquired right-hander José Urquidy from the Pirates in a separate trade.

top_news.title: **Tigers Rout Orioles 14-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dominated the Baltimore Orioles in a one-sided game, securing a 14-0 victory. Eduardo Valencia led the Orioles' offense with 4 hits, including 2 home runs, while Troy Melton pitched 7 strong innings for the Tigers, allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Edge Pirates in Thrilling 8-7 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a hard-fought win against the Pittsburgh Pirates, outlasting their opponents 8-7. Brandon Lowe led the Diamondbacks' offense with a strong performance, collecting 2 hits, including a home run, and driving in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Giants Place Casey Schmitt on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants left fielder Casey Schmitt has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left knee meniscus tear. The injury occurred on July 28, 2026.

top_news.title: **Pirates Acquire Rodríguez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have acquired right fielder Johnathan Rodríguez in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles, who received cash in return.
